name: American Eagle
notes: Dresses page (WebFetch, 2026-10-29): header says 129 items, 30 rendered; 29 of the 30 were marked down 31% (one 50%), e.g. 'was $64.95'. Only one listing was at full price (AE77 Crinkle Lace Slip Cami Dress, $148), so no regular-price dress range is stored.

Shipping: free standard shipping on orders of $75 or more to the US; $7.95 under $75. Returns: full refund within 60 days of purchase; online returns $5 (free for Real Rewards Level 3 and cardmembers).
Wikipedia: headquartered at SouthSide Works, Pittsburgh; founded 1977 by Jerry and Mark Silverman.
